existingReviewFields.S12_in_place_review: Original caller requests a historical RTL relative-name result. Current wrapper asks modern RTL for a full path and clears the original-size result; removing the macro alone changes the ABI. Review a lower owned contract without pulling base_classifier.h into B.

Original conroute.h:29 checks the low two bits. Current predicate also recognizes modern console handles and preserves last error. The common RPC launcher uses the same predicate. No equivalent predicate found in the A/B production sources.

Original vdm.c owns the registry-backed BaseGetVDMKeyword. Current BaseGetVDMKeyword reads the thread-bound package config and returns the selected DOS/WOW command and reservation. Restoring the registry reader alone would select a different configuration source.

Original vdm.c:2368 searches for a fixed system32/ntvdm suffix. The config boundary supplies the exact bound image length and validates its prefix. Evaluate together with C0154 for arbitrary package paths.

Original CSR requests are translated into package RPC by OpenNtBaseClientCallServer. It uses connection, binding and client-process state, validates message size and returns status through the original message. A rename to native CsrClientCallServer would change the endpoint.

The selected worker-thread bridge binds original thread calls to Win32 plus worker session lifetime. Creation preserves the specific callback ABI; exit finishes the current session thread before native exit. Removing the binding in place would bypass session tracking. Check startup and exit together in the ownership review.

Original basedll.h:80-82 defines BASE storage and baseinit.c:270-272 initializes it. Both hook images use hook_classification.c initialized storage; Run16 separately defines and initializes its own descriptors. Review the three together for F-to-C restoration; taking only one executable as provider misses the second binding.

The C USER token check calls NtUserTestForInteractiveUser. F supplies a captured visible-windowstation process logon scope and checks its authentication LUID. Preserve the distinction between original token policy and standalone interactive-scope acquisition in the migration review.

Review together with C0167. The selected process lookup holds the bound service registry lock across a successful return and exposes the registered CSR_PROCESS. Removing this binding alone would change which registry and lock own the result.
Paired with C0166. Match the returned registry object to its lock release, including caller failure paths; do not migrate just one half of the service registry contract.

base_server.h maps CSR_SERVER_QUERYCLIENTTHREAD() to the service thread-local request binding in base_request.c. Lookup requires the currently bound RPC request, not just the process containing the C algorithm.

base_server.h redirects NtClose to the currently bound resource Close operation and otherwise uses native NtClose. Native-only substitution would discard explicit handle ownership supplied at dispatch.

base_server.h redirects NtDuplicateObject. With no bound Duplicate operation the fallback permits only current-process endpoints. Moving only the original call would change delivery and failure semantics; review with C0169.

The original guarded callback is read twice by srvvdm.c. service_core.c supplies null storage. Restoring only the original test of the pointer cannot resolve its data import. Review C storage and original USER initialization in S14; retain the standalone disabled state unless its lifecycle is justified.

Review the correct pointer acquisition/flush pair, selector failure and scratch-video data ownership before deciding whether to bind the original provider.
